title: Constraint-algebra closure and physical degree-of-freedom count obligation
hypothesis: A structural Hamiltonian obligation can reject synthetic fixtures whose declared primary and secondary constraints do not close or whose first- and second-class count disagrees with the preregistered physical degree-of-freedom count.
null_or_failure: An undeclared secondary constraint appears, a bracket fails closure, a second-class constraint is counted as gauge freedom, an odd reduced phase-space dimension passes, units are inconsistent, or a synthetic algebra check is called empirical GMUT confirmation or proof of a healthy theory.
test_falsifier_or_gate: Exercise closed, non-closing, rank-changing, misclassified, odd-dimension, gauge-count, unit-mismatch, and empirical-promotion fixtures; reject every inconsistent constraint or degree-of-freedom declaration while real-data and likelihood counts stay zero.
rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the invalid fixture, retain the counterexample, restore the least committal typed scaffold, and require theory-specific Hamiltonian analysis, well-posedness work, and real observations before any scientific promotion.
boundary: Constraint-algebra fixtures are structural obligations, not proof of a healthy theory or empirical GMUT evidence.
